evidence.note: Read once at startup from the operator's JSON file; topic names and descriptions stay here and are never served.
Reuses a cached classification or classifies the item; one item's failure changes no other.
A stored classification is reused only for the same text digest and configuration digest, and never when it was unavailable.
The only code that reads the classifier's output: parses it and checks each of the four fields against its closed vocabulary; failures become unknown.
Deterministic stand-in for a model; real inference is a later ticket.
The one exit; its schema has no free string, so nothing of the raw output can leave.
The interface takes the text and the topic list and nothing else.
